notes.title: Emergency Meeting! The Tracker Arrives!
notes.content:
To all the Villagers and everyone in Blackwater Town!

Whispers spread through Blackwater… a mysterious new update has arrived! The other factions are about to bite the dust with our newest addition to the Protector faction: 

[h3][b]👣The Tracker, "Spike" [/b][/h3]

Spike has mastered the art of tracking footprints and following movements. With this character in play, you’ll need to watch every step you take, someone might be silently following your every move!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949571/f2c0f2ef3cbc69a914a56d2c81b96f0258daf725.png[/img]
[h3][b]His Abilities[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]✨Active | Mystical Dust:[/b] Secretly throw mystical tracking dust on another player, leaving a trail behind them as they move through the castle.
[*] [b]👁️Passive | Tracker’s Eye:[/b] Use heightened vision to see the dust trails, allowing you to follow players and verify their alibis.
[/list]
[h3][b]💡Playstyle Tips[/b][/h3]
The Tracker thrives on observation and timing.  Don’t be afraid to use your ability early, especially if someone seems suspicious. Throw your dust subtly so the target doesn’t know they’re being tracked. Follow their trail to gather intel and piece together the truth. Take notes to spot patterns, catch liars and reveal them to the group, nothing’s more satisfying than exposing the truth, right? 

[h3][b]📯New Mechanic – Emergency Vote[/b][/h3]
Thanks to your feedback, we’ve added a brand-new mechanic: the Emergency Vote!

[b]📜How it works:[/b]
During the day cycle, players can now call an emergency vote to discuss suspicions and take action without waiting for the normal voting round. Each game allows up to 3 emergency votes. Once per day cycle, players can call for an emergency vote. This brings real-time tension, forcing players to defend or deceive on the spot! [b]Required votes to initiate an Emergency Vote:[/b]
[list]
[*] 5 Players → 3 votes
[*] 6 Players → 3 votes
[*] 7 Players → 4 votes
[*] 8 Players → 4 votes
[*] 9 Players → 5 votes
[*] 10 Players → 5 votes
[/list]
This change will speed up gameplay and make the social deduction aspect even more intense. No more sitting on vital information, you’ll now need to defend or deceive in real-time, adding a whole new layer of strategy. 

[h3][b]🔧Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a spotlight effect during voting rounds for better clarity.
[*] Painful Puzzle task difficulty increased from Easy → Medium.
[/list]
[h3][b]🪲Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Disruptor ability now properly disrupts all abilities including the effect of the Knight shields.
[*] Fixed Werewolf XP progression issues.
[*] Psychic Active Ability: Blocking off a room now has lower visibility at night compared to daytime.
[*] Corrected Werewolf win condition.
[/list]
That's all for now! Make sure to update the game to version number: [b]2.3.3.[/b]

Join us later for our community event and be among the first to play the Tracker and test the Emergency Vote mechanic in action!

notes.title: Custom Lobbies Are Here!
notes.content:
[h3][b]🐛Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix for directional arrow to the task: Forge Fetch
[*] Fix for target click abilities like the Knight/Mentalist/Vigilante occasionally breaking
[/list]
Today we’re unleashing one of the most game-changing updates in Castle of Blackwater’s history:  [h2][b]💥🔥CUSTOM LOBBY SETTINGS!🔥💥[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949571/186153c5ec8116984d97c362b4d7560ecf4f42e9.png[/img]
This is not just an extra toggle here and there. This is handing the keys to the Castle straight to you.

From now on, lobby hosts can fully customize how their games are played, and everyone in the lobby can see the settings before joining. That means no guessing what kind of chaos you’re walking into. 

Here’s some of what’s in your new toolbox:

[h3][b]🔧Fine-tune the rules[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Set voting time duration to keep debates snappy or let them drag on.
[*] Adjust XP requirements and movement speed multipliers for new or veteran-friendly lobbies.
[/list][h3][b]🛡️Control the battlefield[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Define faction distribution per lobby size.
[*] Hand-pick exactly which roles go into the pool for any match.
[*] Choose between specific roles, random roles per faction, or a random role of any faction!
[/list][h3][b]🕵️Twist the difficulty[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Choose whether roles are revealed after someone is voted out.
[*] Hide unreported dead bodies from the dead map until the next day.
[/list]
And that’s just the start! There are more settings to experiment with, break, and push to the limit.
Massive kudos to Kepsert, out Unity Intern for leading the charge on this huge undertaking. This update opens the door to completely new ways to play, and we’re excited (and mildly terrified) to see the chaos you’ll create. 😈

[h3]Go wild![/h3] Try extreme setups with your friends and fellow community members! Share what works, and what completely implodes in our general chat in Discord.

If you find bugs in the stranger edge cases, especially with identical role chaos,  report them in the bug-reports channel so we can refine and expand this system 🐛

We’ll be putting Custom Lobbies to the test in the upcoming Game Nights, so sharpen your ideas.

Let the experiments begin!

notes.title: CASTLE OF BLACKWATER IS GOING FREE-TO-PLAY!
notes.content:
Dear Villagers of Blackwater,

Today, we’re standing at one of the biggest turning points in the history of Castle of Blackwater. After months of updates, experiments, and tough conversations, we’re finally ready to share the decision that will shape the future of this game and its community forever. :heart: 

Let’s rewind for a moment.⌛

Over the past few weeks, we launched the [b]Bloom and Gloom update[/b], redesigned the map for more player interactions, added new animations, and completely overhauled the lighting to make the Castle feel spookier and more alive than ever. The response from those who joined during the Steam Summer Sale was incredible. Players were loving it. 🤩

But despite the best version of Castle we’ve ever shipped, one challenge remained: player liquidity. Even with a discount, even with more marketing than ever before, there was still a barrier stopping new players from trying the game. And without a critical mass of players, matchmaking wasn’t as healthy as it needed to be. 

We asked ourselves some hard questions. Is our mission just to squeeze out a few more sales? Or is it to create the thriving, chaotic, and hilarious community that Castle of Blackwater was always meant to have?

The answer was obvious. 
So here’s the big news: [b]CASTLE OF BLACKWATER IS GOING FREE-TO-PLAY! [/b] 📢 ✨

Yes, you read that right. Starting tomorrow on [b]Wednesday, July 23rd 2025[/b], the Castle doors will be open to everyone. 👐

[previewyoutube=ep9KM4v1H-s;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3] [b]What This Means For Current Players[/b][/h3]
If you’ve already supported us by buying the game, you’re the reason we made it this far. We’re not leaving you behind. In fact, you’re getting some special rewards that free players will never have access to.
[list]
[*] You’ll keep the [b]full collection of 21 starter cosmetics[/b] from the tutorial (which will soon be massively reduced for new players).
[*] You’ll also receive an exclusive [b]Mythical Cosmetic[/b], a one-of-a-kind reward that will [b]NEVER [/b] be made available again.
[/list]
This is our way of saying thank you. Thank you for believing in us early. Thank you for giving feedback, writing reviews, and helping us reach this point. 🫂 

[h3] [b]What This Means For New Players?[/b][/h3]
If you’re new, welcome! The full game is now free. No paywall, no excuses. All we ask is that you respect the community, learn the rules, and help us keep this village fun and welcoming for everyone. The more players we have, the healthier matchmaking becomes, and the more chaotic the Castle will be!😈

[h3] [b]What This Means For Us as Devs?[/b][/h3]
Going free-to-play is a huge shift. It means we can finally scale the player base, fill lobbies faster, and build a sustainable path forward supported by optional cosmetics rather than an upfront price tag.
It won’t be easy. It will mean more moderation, more content, and more technical challenges. But we’re ready, and we’re committed to making this work.

[h3] [b]So What’s Next?[/b][/h3]
Now it’s your turn. If you love this game, share it. Bring your friends. Post the trailer. There’s nothing stopping them from jumping in anymore. We’ll continue hosting weekly game nights, hanging out here in Discord, and working hard to deliver fresh content and improvements.

Villagers, this is just the beginning. The Castle is open.🔥

See you inside.

With love,
Team Blackwater🏰

notes.title: Castle of Blackwater Release Notes 1.1.10
notes.content:
🚨 This is a [b]BIG[/b] one! 🚨

We’ve just pushed one of the most impactful updates to Castle of Blackwater of the year so far — and we’re excited to share it with you. Over the past few weeks, we’ve been deep in the code, refactoring and simplifying core systems to boost stability, reduce load times, and pave the way for big future updates.

But that’s not all... This build also includes major game design changes that will seriously shift how your matches play out. So grab a cup of something magical, read the patch notes carefully, and prepare yourself for a whole new layer of strategic chaos!

As always, thank you for being part of this journey. We're committed to making Castle of Blackwater better every single day. 🏰 

Let’s dive in:
[h2]🛠️ Game Development[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]🆕 Zoom Feature! [/b]– When standing still for a while, your camera will now zoom in slightly, adding tension and cinematic flair to quiet moments. 👁️
[*] [b]🧩 Deadly Duel Rework[/b] – The duel now selects a random minigame instead of always the same one! We’ve also added fresh victory/defeat UI to make it more epic.
[*] [b]Sheriff Feedback[/b] – If the Sheriff searches and fails to find a body, a distinct fail sound will now play to clarify the outcome.
[*] [b]Ghost Dagger Cooldown[/b] (Protector Only) – Ghost daggers now have a cooldown after hitting for Protectors. Satanic ghosts remain unpunished... for now.
[*] [b]Werewolf Win Condition Update[/b] – The Werewolf no longer needs to kill both a Protector and a Satanic — they just need to rack up enough kills. Bloodthirst rewarded. 🐺
[*] [b]Protector Win Condition Tweak[/b] – Protectors can now only win by voting out or eliminating both the Satanic AND the Werewolf in any way, or by finishing the XP of course.
[*] [b]Removed Satanic Kill Sharing[/b] – We've removed the concept of Satanic players needing to share kills in fewer-player lobbies. 
[*] [b]Changed Faction Distribution per Lobby Size [/b]– We've reconfigured the faction distribution logic to line up with all the above faction balancing changes.
[*] [b]Enabled 5 and 6 Player Lobbies [/b]– Thanks to all these changes, it is now possible to start playing a game with a minimum of 5 players instead of 7. (More changes coming to improve this experience)
[*] [b]Dead Shop Inventory Sharing[/b] – Powerup inventory is now shared by faction, meaning if you drain the shop’s stock, your dead teammates are out of luck!
[*] [b]Ambient Sound System Added[/b] – You’ll now hear random atmospheric sounds to deepen immersion and make the castle feel more alive (or haunted). 👻
[*] [b]💀 “Final Word” Powerup Reworked![/b] – Say goodbye to the old, dead ghost voting power. Introducing Ethereal Endorsement: Dead players can now choose one living player to receive a double vote in the next voting round. Political hauntings, anyone?
[/list]
[h2]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the voting timer disappeared for some players.
[*] Fixed broken or disappearing death animations.
[*] Fixed players being able to select the same base color skin (no more clones!).
[*] Rebuilt the entire time system, resolving several major issues like random teleports and vote round glitches.
[*] Fixed player volume settings that were not saving correctly when the UI was closed.
[*] Fixed ghost daggers not being pick-up-able after being thrown.
[*] Implemented fixes that may prevent the black screen loop bug some players experienced after games.
[*] Additional sound system fixes for more consistent and immersive audio.
[/list]
[h2]🔧 Work In Progress[/h2]
We're actively working on:
[list]
[*] Streamlining asset pixel density (PPU) to prepare for mobile porting 📱
[*] Dramatic lighting system to add a whole new visual mood layer 🔦
[*] Ability reworks to improve balance, clarity, and fun ⚡
[*] Smaller map variant focused on tighter foot traffic and faster games 🗺️
[/list]
Grab your friends, hop into a lobby, and come try out everything new in 1.1.10. We’ll see you in the castle. And as always… 

Stay spooky!!! 👻

notes.title: Castle of Blackwater v1.1.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
Over the past few weeks, we’ve been hard at work behind the scenes, making Castle of Blackwater a smoother, more intuitive, and more stable experience for everyone, especially for first-time players stepping into the castle for the very first time. 

From quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes to polish passes and UX upgrades, this update is all about boosting clarity and stability without compromising on the charm and chaos you know and love. We’ve also focused on continuing to improve the experience for our returning players with a mix of requested tweaks, fixes, and behind-the-scenes tuning. :flip: 

Chatting with so many of you in Discord has been awesome. Your feedback, bug reports, and spicy hot takes have been a huge help. We hope you spot your suggestions and ideas in this update, and if not, don’t worry; there’s more coming. 

Without further ado, here’s what’s new in Build 1.1.0 🏰👇

[h3]🛠️ Game Development[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Upgraded Unity Engine[/b] – We’ve upgraded our Unity version to improve overall stability and reduce random crashes. This also unlocks exciting new tech we’re looking forward to experimenting with soon.
[*] [b]Upgraded Photon Networking[/b] – Our new Photon version comes with better networking performance and lays the groundwork for potential reconnect features in the future.
[*] [b]Refactored Sound System[/b] – We overhauled our sound system for better consistency, performance, and creative flexibility in future sound design.
[*] [b]Temporary Character Size Increase[/b] – Characters are now 20% larger, making it easier to traverse the map and show off your latest cosmetic drip.
[*] [b]Safe Zone Minigame Fix[/b] – The Safe Zone pop-up no longer interrupts active minigames.
[*] [b]Visible In-Game Lobbies[/b] – Players can now see lobbies that are currently in progress to decide whether to wait or search for another.
[*] [b]Body Report Sound[/b] – A new global bell sound plays when a body is reported, slightly buffing the Sheriff and turning up the tension.
[*] [b]Player Audio Settings[/b] – New settings UI allows players to individually mute or adjust the volume of other players.
[*] [b]Ghost Projectile Diminishing Returns[/b] – Getting hit by multiple ghost daggers now has diminishing effects, reducing the chance of spam kills.
[*] [b]Werewolf Sound Fix[/b] – Players in the Safe Zone will no longer hear the werewolf howl when a transformation occurs.
[*] [b]Push-to-Talk Added[/b] – Now available in the settings for those who prefer more controlled voice chat.
[*] [b]Musical Flames Rework[/b] – Slightly simplified and sped up: one fewer step and faster timing.
[*] [b]Voting Round Duration Increased[/b] – Discussion time increased from 45s → 60s and defense time from 10s → 12s.
[*] [b]Ghost Soul Economy Rebalancing[/b] – Reduced ghost soul spawn rate and increased prices for some ghost powerups to tighten the late-game loop.
[/list]
[h3]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Vigilante Blood Effect[/b] – Vigilantes now get blood on their hands after a successful kill.
[*] [b]Ability Use Bugs Fixed[/b] – Fixed several bugs where player abilities couldn’t be used in specific areas.
[*] [b]Sound Glitches Resolved[/b] – A broad sweep of sound-related bugs has been resolved for cleaner, more immersive audio.
[*] [b]Tutorial Stability Pass[/b] – Fixed multiple issues that could cause the tutorial to break or leave players stuck.
[*] [b]Ghost Dagger Debuff Timing[/b] – Fixed a bug where the confusion effect lingered too long after being hit by ghost daggers.
[*] [b]Room Names on Mini-map[/b] – Fixed display issues where room names weren’t appearing on the mini-map.
[*] [b]Disconnected Bodies Reporting[/b] – Dead bodies from disconnected players can now be reported correctly.
[*] [b]Book of Tasks Exploit[/b] – Patched an exploit allowing players to open the Book of Tasks just before teleporting after a vote.
[*] [b]Psychic Ability Safe Zone Bug[/b] – Psychic ability now properly renders the correct map, even when used in the safe zone.
[*] [b]Localization Fixes[/b] – Numerous language/localization issues across different UIs have been corrected.
[*] [b]Record Keeper Note Bug[/b] – Fixed an issue where the death note would appear multiple times.
[*] [b]Outfit Save Issue[/b] – Fixed a bug that prevented players from saving new outfits in the lobby inventory screen.
[*] [b]Rematch Lobby Fix[/b] – Public games now correctly stay public after a rematch.
[*] [b]Dead Ghost UI Bug[/b] – Ghosts can now properly interact with all components in the player list UI.
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
Just a quick heads-up: a few issues remain to be fixed. We didn't want these to prevent us from uploading before the weekend, but keep this in mind and don't worry about reporting these known issues:

[list]
[*] If the host player (the one who started the lobby) disconnects from an active game, the whole game will crash for everyone left in it. (this is a complex networking issue that we'll fix next week)
[*] Sometimes, some players won't see the time in the voting round
[*] The ghostly dagger, although better than yesterday, isn't as smooth as we want it to
[*] The player menu in the settings panel doesn't save your preferences when you close it.
[/list]
If you find any other issues than the above, please let us know!!

[h3]👀 What’s Next?[/h3]
As always, while we’ve squashed a lot of bugs and made big improvements in this patch, we know the work isn’t done. Our next area of focus revolves around making a new smaller map, implementing a cool new system for environmental lighting, and making a lot of improvements to mechanics and abilities to increase their clarity in gameplay. After that's completed, we'll move on to the next phase, which will include host settings, new characters, and more retention systems 🙂

notes.title: 🏰 A New Chapter Begins in the Castle 🏰
notes.content:
Dear Villagers of Blackwater, 

As we reflect back on a crazy 2 weeks surrounding the launch of Castle of Blackwater, we’ve come out the other end with a clearer vision of our way forward than ever before. 

Our goal going into launch was simple; create enough of a buzz to quickly scale the game to a couple hundred CCU, ensuring that any new player can login and find a lobby quickly. 

Although we did everything we could think of to force our way into a stable foundation of player liquidity, we have to accept that the road ahead will be slightly more turbulent than we would have liked it to be. Nevertheless, the Castle of Blackwater team remains committed to the ongoing development of our game. 

Before we dive into our plans for the next few months, let’s first take a moment to appreciate everyone who came out in support of our launch. From those who have been around for a long time, to those who have just discovered us through following their favourite streamer, Castle of Blackwater welcomes you all. 

The amount of positivity we received from our early players has been nothing short of amazing. And though the active player count may not yet be where we wanted it to be, we’ve found a lot of energy from the many favourable comments and reviews we have thus far received. 

That being said, watching large groups of inexperienced players play our game for the first time has also been eye-opening! Issues that we thought were easily overlooked became more glaringly problematic, and with an audience of tens of thousands of potential players, every slightest imperfection suddenly seemed like a massively missed opportunity. 

Those of you who know us by now will know that we don’t give up easily! So, after some internal strategizing, here’s our game plan for the next few months: 

[h3]🛠️  Upgrading our core systems for increased stability 🛠️ [/h3]
Due to our intense pace of development the past 2 years, we’ve slightly neglected on updating some of our core systems that we use to create Castle of Blackwater. Now that we have some more breathing room, we plan to upgrade our Unity and Networking services, so that we can find more stability and access additional quality of life features. 

[h3]🗺️ New smaller map! 🗺️ [/h3]
We’ve already started on designing a new map, that will be smaller and have fewer routes between key areas. We believe this will force more player-to-player interactions and create possibilities for a 5-player game. 
 
[h3]📱 Let’s go mobile📱 [/h3]
One of our big goals this year is to port Castle of Blackwater to mobile, as an ad-supported free-to-play game, with cross-play capability. Doing so will allow us to tap into a much bigger player base, with no barrier to entry, to ensure better player liquidity. 

[h3]💻 Host Settings Controls 💻 [/h3]
Another piece of great feedback that we’ll soon be acting on is allowing lobby hosts to change different settings within their lobby, giving them control over balancing features and allowing them to set their own difficulties. This will solve many balancing issues and ensure that lobbies can play according to their preferred rule sets.

[h3]🚀Miscellaneous 🚀 [/h3]
Beyond these major projects, we’ll also continue to push out new characters, minigames, powerups, and feature reworks. At the same time, we’ll also continue to experiment with different marketing initiatives in order to facilitate a steady player growth. 

We really appreciate everyone’s support and patience as we enter this next chapter of our release. We promise to keep working hard and listening to your feedback, so that we can continue to evolve the game into the potential we all know it has. 

While we do so, we’ll also continue to organise weekly game nights, events, challenges and other initiatives, as well as be around in Discord every day to talk with you all about our future. 

Until then, we hope to see you in the Castle! 

With love, 
Team Blackwater. 🏰

[*] [b]Voice Chat Overhaul[/b] – Simplified voice chat controls in the settings panel and added per-player volume controls in the right-click player options menu. Communication has never been clearer.  
[*] [b]Player Analytics[/b] – A new version of player analytics has been added to help us understand how you interact with the game and improve it even further.  
[*] [b]New Emote Sounds & Songs[/b] – Check out the latest emotes, featuring a variety of sounds and songs to enhance gameplay.

[/list]

[*] Fixed various issues causing dead ghosts to get stuck or freeze in place.  
[*] Resolved a bug that prevented new players from saving their load-outs.  
[*] Fixed the recordkeeper note not displaying correctly during voting rounds.  
[*] Addressed frequent teleporting issues for dead ghosts that caused maps to fail to load.  
[*] Fixed player list breaking under specific conditions.  
[*] Locked player movement while interacting with the lobby inventory to prevent unintended glitches.  
[*] Ensured the lumberjack ability cannot be used while in a minigame.  
[*] Implemented stability fixes for player disconnects during voting rounds.  
[*] Fixed several minor broken UI elements.  
[*] Resolved an issue where long player names broke non-dynamic UI frames.  
[*] Fixed a bug where the game wouldn’t end after five turns.  
[*] Resolved an issue causing the psychic ability to trigger twice.  
[*] Fixed the "You’ve been silenced" text not disappearing after a player’s death.  
[*] Fixed a bug where winning as Werewolf was not displayed on the victory screen.  
[*] Resolved an issue where emote sounds weren’t playing in the inventory.  
[*] Fixed layering issues and improvements in various minigames.

tags.feature: [b]Localization is here![/b] Castle of Blackwater is now available in English, Turkish, Spanish, Dutch, German, French, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, and Russian.

tags.balance_change: [b]Werewolf Adjustment[/b] – Prey targets no longer see the werewolf on the minimap when a soul is picked up (but can still hear him). Surviving just got a whole lot harder.

tags.feature: [b]Anti-Cheat Upgrades[/b] – Two non-intrusive versions of anti-cheat have been implemented to keep the gameplay fair and enjoyable for everyone.
[b]Voice Chat Overhaul[/b] – Simplified voice chat controls in the settings panel and added per-player volume controls in the right-click player options menu. Communication has never been clearer.
[b]Player Analytics[/b] – A new version of player analytics has been added to help us understand how you interact with the game and improve it even further.
[b]New Emote Sounds & Songs[/b] – Check out the latest emotes, featuring a variety of sounds and songs to enhance gameplay.
[b]Automatic Ready-Up[/b] – Players are now automatically marked as ready when moving into a newly joined lobby.

tags.balance_change: [b]Book Stack Improvements[/b] – Significant changes have been made to Book Stack, making it a much more balanced and engaging experience.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where the sound manager wouldn’t destroy itself upon leaving the lobby, preventing multiple music tracks from overlapping.
Fixed various issues causing dead ghosts to get stuck or freeze in place.
Resolved a bug that prevented new players from saving their load-outs.
Fixed the recordkeeper note not displaying correctly during voting rounds.
Addressed frequent teleporting issues for dead ghosts that caused maps to fail to load.
Fixed player list breaking under specific conditions.
Locked player movement while interacting with the lobby inventory to prevent unintended glitches.
Ensured the lumberjack ability cannot be used while in a minigame.
Implemented stability fixes for player disconnects during voting rounds.
Fixed several minor broken UI elements.
Resolved an issue where long player names broke non-dynamic UI frames.
Fixed a bug where the game wouldn’t end after five turns.
Resolved an issue causing the psychic ability to trigger twice.
Fixed the "You’ve been silenced" text not disappearing after a player’s death.
Fixed a bug where winning as Werewolf was not displayed on the victory screen.
Resolved an issue where emote sounds weren’t playing in the inventory.
Fixed layering issues and improvements in various minigames.
